purpose: Evaluate native Wingless R8 conditional online belief updates against frozen R5 and matched conventional baselines in original source MiniGrid. No superiority presupposed.

cohorts.rule: Disjoint from historical F5 71400/72400/73400 cohorts. No selection, fitting or tuning on CHECK.

comparators: independent equal-information conditional Beta posterior (expected R8 tie)
stronger full-public-map conventional planner where observation access is equalized
primary_metrics: CHECK goal completion by world and seed
CHECK reward and steps to goal
unfamiliar-family transfer from FIT to held-out CHECK
two-process byte-stable replay on identical frozen inputs
controls: FIT only learns and tunes; CHECK only evaluates
equal observations, actions, environment resets and step budgets
fail closed on source SHA, source blob, missing control or replay divergence
report all seeds and all negatives
do not use protected FSA or assert scientific acceptance from development runs
decision_rule: Report R8-vs-R5 and each conventional comparator with per-world paired seed deltas. R8 does not qualify as superior if matched conditional Beta ties or outperforms it. No scientific promotion without independent source-authentic replay and custody approval.
execution: NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_FILE; separate runner workflow and source-authentic experiment implementation must be reviewed before first run
